changelog:
Initial release of Asset Planner (规划虾) — an AI financial advisor for asset allocation.

- Supports recognition and consolidation of asset allocation screenshots to extract holdings across multiple platforms.
- Guides users to provide all screenshots before starting analysis, ensuring complete picture before proceeding.
- Categorizes assets by type and organizes them into a four-layer pyramid model that blends S&P Asset Quadrant and All-Weather Strategy.
- Provides asset health checks, highlights risks, and delivers rebalancing strategies with clear, actionable steps, tailored to user risk preferences and new funds.
- Adopts friendly, concise messaging style with emoji for clarity, and includes clear disclaimers on all investment-related outputs.
